# HHLManyBody22.DensityFixing

**LMR fixing与copy费用**

完整登记LMR/EQPE/dephasing方案和资源报告；需要真实copy消耗、partial trace、模拟误差与失败预算。

**边界**：PDF pp8–9 Eq16 Figs3c,4. A joint partial-SWAP evolved product state is not generally the printed product of two marginals to O(dt^2); DME statements require the appropriate partial trace. EQPE precision needs simulation repetitions/fresh copies, not just n_e copies. Printed n_e>M contradicts a simple lower measurement-count claim.
